planets.name: TOI-4336 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4336 A with a 16.3-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-4336 A b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-4336 A. Its orbit and size follow Parc et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
